एतय एकटा आओर झरना अछि। जेना-जेना अमेरिका अपनऽ प्रतिबद्धता स॑ हटतै, ई संकेत दै छै कि कोय नियम या कर्तव्य नै छै, आरू सचमुच जलवायु टूटै म॑ बिल्कुल भी दिक्कत नै छै, दोसरऽ देशऽ प॑ आरू योगदान दै के दबाव बढ़तै । हुनका सब क॑ एक अस्थिर करऽ वाला वर्चस्व केरऽ छाया म॑ एक समन्वित प्रतिक्रिया क॑ एक साथ रखै के तरीका खोजै के जरूरत होतै, साथ ही साथ राजनीतिक समाज-विकृति के समय म॑ वू सामाजिक दायित्व के भावना क॑ बढ़ावा दै के कोशिश करै के जरूरत होतै ।

एहि सबहक मूर्खतापूर्ण अदूरदर्शिता ई जे अनुभवक बीच भले पैघ अंतर हो, आ तें ई भाव जे ओतय सब ठाम ग्लेशियर आ बाढ़ि आ अकाल भ रहल अछि, ओकर नॉक-ऑन प्रभाव आ खाद्य आपूर्तिक चुनौती, आ राजनीतिक आ शरणार्थी संकट, हमरा सब कें प्रभावित करत. हॉटस्पॉट के लेल हालात नाटकीय रूप सं खराब भ जाएत, मुदा एखनो दीर्घकाल मे एहि सब सं आगू बढ़य वाला कोनो बात नहिं अछि. लगै छै कि ठीक वैह क्षण जब॑ ई एहसास हमरा सब क॑ जीवन म॑ तेजी स॑ बदलै वाला सब तरीका म॑ एक साथ जोड़ना चाहियऽ, त॑ हम्मं॑ सब के बान्हलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै । लेकिन अंततः हम सब जे भी अलग-अलग गोला में निवास करी, हम सब एखनो एकहि ग्रह पर फंसल छी।

title: Nepal's hesitance to accept foreign help for flood relief under scrutiny - NPR
description: Nepal's hesitance to accept foreign help for flood relief under scrutiny  NPR
publisher.title: NPR
full_article:
A drone view of the aftermath of flash flooding along the Trishuli river amidst fresh water surge warning in the Trishuli Bazaar area of Nuwakot district, Nepal, Sunday, Aug. 30, 2026. (AP Photo/Rajesh Kumar Singh) Rajesh Kumar Singh/AP hide caption toggle caption Rajesh Kumar Singh/AP

MUMBAI, India – As authorities in Nepal scramble to rescue more than 900 workers trapped in hydropower tunnels that are still under construction, a top group of the country's private sector power producers has criticized the government's initial hesitance in accepting help from other countries.

The floods and mudslides that were triggered by last week's ice-and-rock avalanche have buried several Himalayan villages in the border region of Nepal and Tibet.

In a statement on Monday morning local time, Nepal's disaster management department said 903 people have died and 4,247 are currently considered missing, a sharp rise on the previous figures. At least 85 of those missing are Americans, the State Department said on Sunday.

Sponsor Message

The debris created by the various landslides have also blocked nine hydropower tunnels in Nepal's Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts, trapping 933 workers from Nepal, South Korea and China. Videos shared by the Nepali army show rescue personnel using drills and excavator machines to try and rescue those who were trapped.

Bhim Gautam, chief executive officer of the Independent Power Producers Association of Nepal , told NPR that Nepal does not have "enough technology, equipment and expertise" to mount successful rescue operations at hydropower projects. "Our expertise is only in dealing with small flooding. We have never faced a situation like this before," said Gautam.

Last week's floods, he said, not only blocked the entrances of the tunnels, but also made them difficult to locate. "In some cases, the rescue workers spent three days only in finding these tunnels."

He said his industry's leaders had to "pressure the government" to allow rescue workers from other countries. "Late last week, the government approved rescue teams from China, India and Australia to come," Gautam said. "But it is so late now."

Nepal's finance minister Swarnim Wagle had last week rejected reports in local and international media that asserted the country had rejected help from foreign countries, insisting that assistance had been accepted only "according to the needs on the ground."

Sponsor Message

In a statement posted to Facebook Sunday, prime minister Balen Shah said the Nepali army and police, along with experts from India, China and South Korea, were now carrying out rescue operations at various hydropower tunnels.The Nepali government has been contacted for comment.

Fatality figures in China under question

Meanwhile in China on Monday, the country's foreign ministry denied reports that officials in Beijing had ignored early warning signs of the disaster or downplayed the details of casualties.

It insisted that the country's release of information about the floods and mudslide near its border with Nepal had been transparent and timely.

मुंबई, भारत – नेपाल केरऽ अधिकारियऽ न॑ जलविद्युत सुरंगऽ म॑ फंसलऽ ९०० स॑ भी अधिक मजदूरऽ क॑ बचाबै लेली दौड़-धूप करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ देश केरऽ निजी क्षेत्र केरऽ बिजली उत्पादकऽ के एगो शीर्ष समूह न॑ सरकार केरऽ दोसरऽ देशऽ स॑ मदद स्वीकार करै म॑ शुरूआती संकोच के आलोचना करलकै ।

पिछला सप्ताह बर्फ आ चट्टान के हिमस्खलन के कारण जे बाढ़ि आ कीचड़ के झटका लागल छल ओहि सं नेपाल आ तिब्बत के सीमावर्ती क्षेत्र के कईटा हिमालयी गाम दफना गेल अछि.

नेपालके आपदा प्रबंधन विभाग सोमदिन भोरके स्थानीय समयके विज्ञप्तिमे ९०३ गोटेके मृत्यु भेल अछि आ ४ हजार २४७ गोटेके अखन लापता मानल जा रहल अछि, जे पछिला आंकड़ासँ बेसी अछि । विदेश विभाग रविदिन कहलनि जे, लापता मे सं कम सं कम 85 अमेरिकी छथि.

प्रायोजक संदेश

विभिन्न भूस्खलन सँ उत्पन्न मलबा नेपालक रसुवा आ नुवाकोट जिलाक नौ जलविद्युत सुरंग सेहो अवरुद्ध कएने अछि जाहि सँ नेपाल, दक्षिण कोरिया आ चीनक ९३३ मजदूर फँसि गेल अछि । नेपाली सेना द्वारा साझा कएल गेल वीडियो मे बचावकर्मी ड्रिल आ एक्सकेवेटर मशीन के उपयोग कए फंसल लोक के बचाबय के कोशिश करैत देखा रहल अछि।

नेपालके स्वतन्त्र विद्युत उत्पादक संघके मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी भीम गौतम एनपीआरके बतौलनि जे नेपाल लग जलविद्युत परियोजनामे सफल बचाव कार्य माउन्ट करबाक लेल “एतना तकनीक, उपकरण आ विशेषज्ञता” नहि अछि । गौतम कहला जे हमर विशेषज्ञता केवल छोट-छोट बाढ़ि स निपटबा मे अछि, एहि तरहक स्थिति क सामना पहिने कहियो नहि भेल अछि।

ओ कहला जे पिछला सप्ताह बाढ़ि स सुरंग क प्रवेश द्वार त बंद भ गेल, संगहि एकर पता लगेबा मे सेहो दिक्कत भ गेल। "किछु मामला मे बचावकर्मी तीन दिन मात्र एहि सुरंग कए खोजबा मे बिता देलक।"

हुनी कहलकै कि हुनकऽ उद्योग केरऽ नेता सिनी क॑ ‘सरकार प॑ दबाव डालना’ छै कि दोसरऽ देशऽ स॑ बचावकर्मी क॑ अनुमति मिल॑ सक॑ । गौतम कहलनि जे, पिछला सप्ताह के अंत मे सरकार चीन, भारत आ ऑस्ट्रेलिया के बचाव दल के आबय के मंजूरी द देलक। "मुदा आब एतेक देर भ' गेल अछि।"

नेपाल केरऽ वित्त मंत्री स्वर्णिम वागले न॑ पिछला सप्ताह स्थानीय आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मीडिया म॑ ऐसनऽ खबर क॑ खारिज करी देल॑ छेलै जेकरा म॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छेलै कि देश न॑ विदेशी देशऽ के मदद क॑ खारिज करी देल॑ छै आरू ई बात प॑ जोर देल॑ छेलै कि सहायता केवल “जमीन प॑ जरूरत के अनुसार” ही स्वीकार करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

प्रायोजक संदेश

रविदिन फेसबुक पर देल गेल विज्ञप्ति मे प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन् शाह भारत, चीन आ दक्षिण कोरियाक विशेषज्ञक संग नेपाली सेना आ पुलिस आब विभिन्न जलविद्युत सुरंग पर बचाव अभियान चला रहल बतौलनि ।नेपाल सरकार सँ टिप्पणी करबाक लेल सम्पर्क कएल गेल अछि ।

चीन मे जानलेवा आंकड़ा पर सवाल उठल अछि

एम्हर चीन म॑ सोमवार क॑ देश केरऽ विदेश मंत्रालय न॑ ई खबर क॑ खारिज करी देलकै कि बीजिंग केरऽ अधिकारियऽ न॑ आपदा केरऽ पूर्व चेतावनी संकेत क॑ नजरअंदाज करी देल॑ छै या जानमाल के नुकसान के विवरण क॑ कम करी देल॑ छै ।

नेपाल के साथ अपनऽ सीमा के पास बाढ़ आरू कीचड़ के स्खलन के बारे म॑ देश द्वारा जारी करलऽ गेलऽ जानकारी पारदर्शी आरू समयानुकूल होय के बात प॑ जोर देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

ATLANTA, Ga. (Atlanta News First) — The death toll continues to climb in Nepal after catastrophic flash floods and landslides crashed into villages along the Tibet border.

Authorities on the ground are still trying to find thousands of missing people as floodwaters continue to recede in inaccessible areas.

Effects of the disaster have even reached metro Atlanta. A Canton family is desperately looking for answers for their loved one. Mary Sorensen was last seen at an immigration center before traveling toward Kathmandu, according to her family.

READ: Canton woman remains missing as Atlanta’s Nepali community mourns flood victims

Looking for loved ones in Nepal? Read this

According to the Red Cross, U.S. family members unable to contact loved ones in Nepal can initiate a search through the organization’s Restoring Family Links program or call their free national helpline at +1 844-782-9441. Note that there may be a delay before your request is processed.

You can also report a missing person and request welfare assistance from the U.S. State Department by contacting its Office of Overseas Citizens Services at 1-888-407-4747 (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET).

At last count, about 90 Americans were unaccounted for after the flash floods in Nepal and Tibet.

title: Nepal-Tibet floods: rescuers race to reach 900 people believed trapped in hydropower tunnels - The Guardian
description: Nepal-Tibet floods: rescuers race to reach 900 people believed trapped in hydropower tunnels  The Guardian
publisher.title: The Guardian
full_article:
Rescue teams are working to reach more than 900 people thought to be trapped in the tunnels and underground areas of half a dozen hydropower projects in Nepal following the devastating flash floods, ​the ⁠country’s disaster ​management authority said ​on ​Monday.

The death toll from the ⁠unprecedented deluge of ice, rock, mud ​and debris that crashed through valleys of Nepal on Wednesday last week has now risen to 903 people, with 16 more dead reported on the Tibet side of the border. More than 4,000 are missing in Nepal, with another 500 in Tibet.

Hundreds of bodies, many unidentified, have been buried in shallow graves on the plains ⁠of the Himalayan region after being swept down the mountains by the torrent.

Nepali officials said on Monday the focus was on reaching the 933 people missing from ‌hydropower projects in the flood-hit region.

Devastated by floods and overwhelmed by bodies, Nepalis weep for what remains of their homes Read more

Pictures and videos shared by rescue teams ⁠showed earth-moving equipment digging and shovelling mud to try to access the tunnels. “A large amount of debris has been deposited and that is posing us a big challenge to open the tunnels,” said Nepal army spokesperson Raja Ram Basnet.

Ashish Gurung, who normally works as a guide, was among the rescuers. “There is just mud everywhere,” he told the Guardian. “Inside the tunnel it was worse. It’s so difficult to move, the mud is so deep.”

On Sunday his team was trying to access Chilime Hydropower in Ruswana, in the worst-hit area.

Mountaineers improvised by grabbing planks of wood to check the depth of the mud, before using them as a makeshift bridge, along with a system of ropes to keep themselves safe, he said.

“Walking in it is very difficult; at one point it was up to our chests,” Gurung said. “We got close to the first station, about 130 metres in. Inside that far, you could [see further in]; it looked like it was just bodies.”

View image in fullscreen Ashish Gurung, left, with fellow rescue mountaineer Jenjen Lama at the Chilime Hydropower in Ruswana, Nepal. Photograph: supplied

The hydro company had given his team a map and it looked like there was a chance people in the tunnels could have survived by staying inside the internal infrastructure.

“They have a safe area inside,” he said. “Some of them could potentially be alive. I am hoping they are alive.”

Young girl rescued from rubble three days after Nepal flash flood – video

The Red Cross has ‌estimated that more than 90,000 people are likely to have been affected by the disaster, which China and some experts linked to the effects of the climate crisis.

Nepal’s prime minister, Balendra Shah, said the flood was an “unprecedented and devastating natural disaster” and it remained challenging to compile a complete assessment of the damage.

“Despite the adverse weather, difficult terrain and continuing risks, we are moving forward with determination to save the lives of our citizens,” he said in a Facebook post late on Sunday. Almost 21,000 security personnel were involved in the rescue operations, besides civilian workers and volunteers, he added.

Nepal’s disaster agency said on Monday that 903 deaths had been counted there, with 4,247 people, including 592 foreigners, missing. As of Sunday, Chinese authorities reported 16 deaths and 546 missing, and Chinese state media said 261 of the missing were foreigners, including over a hundred Nepalis.

China’s state-run CCTV reported that Beijing had mobilised more than 2,100 rescue workers and allocated at least ​220m yuan ($33m) to support relief efforts and had been airdropping equipment and supplies to frontline rescuers, while its soldiers used life-detection equipment to look for the missing.

View image in fullscreen Rescuers use diggers on Monday to clear way to a tunnel of the Trishuli 3A Hydropower project, following deadly flash floods and a mudslide, in Nuwakot district, Nepal. Photograph: Nepal Army/Reuters

Nepal has said it does not need foreign help in general search and rescue operations, but it has leaned on neighbours India and China for their expertise in tunnel rescues.

Rescue operations have been suspended several times since Friday because of bad weather and concerns that a lake formed across the Nepal-China border by the disaster could trigger fresh flooding after it began overflowing into Nepal’s rivers.

However, the weather was good on Monday and rescue ⁠work continued to pick up pace, said Narendra Pariyar, the district administrator of Rasuwa, one of the two hard-hit districts.

In the holy ​town of Devighat, on the banks of the Trishuli river that ​flooded, residents walked around the shells of what had once been ​homes, trying to salvage their belongings from the debris.

locator

The flood was “caused by glacier instability under the long-term effects of global warming”, Chinese state broadcaster CCTV reported, saying ​it was a “new and prominent feature of cryosphere ‌disasters” on the Tibetan plateau.

Two ​Nepali officials told Reuters that China had ​not shared much information on glacier risks and water levels following a meeting to strengthen cooperation earlier this year, and they feared that a lack of data sharing could hamper future disaster preparedness.

China’s foreign ministry did not respond to a request for comment on the meeting.

बचाव टीम द्वारा साझा करलऽ गेलऽ तस्वीर आरू वीडियो म॑ ⁠सुरंगऽ म॑ पहुँचै के कोशिश म॑ माटी क॑ चलै वाला उपकरण खोदना आरू कीचड़ फावड़ा स॑ बाहर निकालै के काम करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । नेपाल सेना प्रवक्ता राजा राम बस्नेत कहलनि जे, भारी मात्रा मे मलबा जमा भ गेल अछि आ ताहि स हमरा सब कए सुरंग खोलबा मे पैघ चुनौती अछि।

रविदिन हुनकऽ टीम रुसवाना केरऽ चिलीम जलविद्युत तक पहुँचै के कोशिश करी रहलऽ छेलै, जे सबसें जादा प्रभावित क्षेत्र छेकै ।

ओ कहला जे पर्वतारोही लकड़ी क तख्ता पकड़ि कए थाल क गहराई क जांच करैत इम्प्रूवमेंट केलथि, एहि स पहिने ओकरा अस्थायी पुल क रूप मे उपयोग केलथि, संगहि अपना कए सुरक्षित रखबा लेल रस्सी क सिस्टम सेहो।

गुरुंग कहलनि जे, एहि मे चलब बहुत कठिन अछि, एक समय मे इ हमरा सबहक छाती तक छल। “हमरा लोकनि पहिल स्टेशनक नजदीक पहुँचलहुँ, लगभग १३० मीटर भीतर.. भीतर एतेक दूर धरि, अहाँ [आगू भीतर देखि सकैत छलहुँ]; लागैत छल जेना ई मात्र लाश अछि।”

फुलस्क्रीन में छवि देखें आशीष गुरुंग, बाएं, नेपाल के रुसवाना में चिलीमे जलविद्युत में साथी बचाव पर्वतारोही जेनजेन लामा के साथ | फोटोग्राफ: आपूर्ति कयल गेल

हाइड्रो कंपनी अपन टीम कए नक्शा द देने छल आ एहन लागैत छल जे सुरंग मे बैसल लोक आंतरिक बुनियादी ढांचा क भीतर रहि कए जीवित रहबाक मौका अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, हुनका सब के अंदर सुरक्षित इलाका अछि। "ओहि मे सँ किछु संभावित रूप सँ जीवित भ' सकैत अछि, हम आशा क' रहल छी जे ओ जीवित छथि।"

नेपाल मे फ्लैश फ्लड के तीन दिन बाद मलबे स बचाओल गेल युवती – वीडियो

रेड क्रॉस केरऽ अनुमान छै कि ई आपदा स॑ ९०,००० स॑ भी अधिक लोगऽ क॑ प्रभावित होय के संभावना छै, जेकरा चीन आरू कुछ विशेषज्ञ न॑ जलवायु संकट केरऽ प्रभाव स॑ जोड़लकै ।

नेपाल केरऽ प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह न॑ कहलकै कि ई बाढ़ एगो “अभूतपूर्व आरू विनाशकारी प्राकृतिक आपदा” छेकै आरू नुकसान केरऽ पूरा आकलन करना चुनौतीपूर्ण बनलऽ छै ।

रविदिन देर राति फेसबुक पोस्ट मे ओ कहलनि जे, प्रतिकूल मौसम, कठिन इलाका आ लगातार जोखिम के बावजूद हम सब अपन नागरिक के जान बचाबय के संकल्प के संग आगू बढ़ि रहल छी। ओ आगू कहलनि जे, बचाव अभियान मे लगभग 21 हजार सुरक्षाकर्मी शामिल छल, एकर अलावा नागरिक मजदूर आ स्वयंसेवक सेहो शामिल छल।

नेपालक आपदा एजेंसी सोमदिन कहलनि जे, ओतय 903 गोटेक मृत्यु भेल अछि, जाहि मे 592 विदेशी सहित 4247 लोक लापता अछि। रविदिन धरि चीन के अधिकारी 16 के मौत आ 546 के लापता होय के खबरि देलक अछि, आ चीनी सरकारी मीडिया के कहनाय छनि जे लापता मे सं 261 गोटे विदेशी छथि, जाहि मे सौ सं बेसी नेपाली सेहो शामिल छथि.

चीन केरऽ सरकारी सीसीटीवी न॑ खबर देल॑ छै कि बीजिंग न॑ २,१०० स॑ भी अधिक बचावकर्मी क॑ जुटान॑ छै आरू राहत प्रयासऽ म॑ सहायता लेली कम स॑ कम २२० मिलियन युआन (३३ मिलियन डॉलर) के आवंटन करलकै आरू फ्रंटलाइन बचावकर्ता सिनी क॑ उपकरण आरू आपूर्ति हवाई ड्रॉप करी रहलऽ छै, जबकि ओकरऽ सैनिक न॑ लापता लोगऽ क॑ खोजै लेली जीवन-पता लगाबै वाला उपकरण के इस्तेमाल करलकै ।

View image in fullscreen नेपाल के नुवाकोट जिला में त्रिशुली 3ए जलविद्युत परियोजना के सुरंग के रास्ता साफ करय लेल सोमदिन बचावकर्मी के उपयोग करैत अछि. फोटोग्राफ : नेपाल सेना/रायटर

नेपाल कहलनि अछि जे सामान्य खोज आ बचाव कार्य मे विदेशी मदद के जरूरत नहि अछि, मुदा सुरंग बचाव मे विशेषज्ञता के लेल पड़ोसी देश भारत आ चीन पर भरोसा केलक अछि।

खराब मौसम आरू आपदा स॑ नेपाल-चीन सीमा पार स॑ बनलऽ झील नेपाल केरऽ नदी म॑ उफन॑ लगला के बाद ताजा बाढ़ के शुरुआत होय सकै छै, एकरऽ चिंता के वजह स॑ शुक्रवार स॑ ही कई बार बचाव कार्य बंद होय गेलऽ छै ।

हालांकि सोमदिन मौसम नीक रहल आ बचाव ⁠काम गति बढ़ैत रहल, ई बात कड़ा प्रभावित दू जिला मे स एक रसुवा क जिला प्रशासक नरेंद्र परियार कहला।

पवित्र नगर देवीघाट में, बाढ़ि में डूबल त्रिशूली नदी के कात में, निवासी सब जे कहियो घर छल, ओकर गोला में घुमैत छल, मलबा सं अपन सामान बचाबय के कोशिश में.

लोकेटर

चीनी सरकारी प्रसारक सीसीटीवी न॑ खबर देलकै कि ई बाढ़ “ग्लोशियर वार्मिंग केरऽ दीर्घकालिक प्रभाव के तहत ग्लेशियर अस्थिरता के वजह स॑ पैदा होय गेलऽ छै” आरू कहलकै कि ई तिब्बती पठार प॑ “क्रायोस्फीयर आपदा केरऽ एगो नया आरू प्रमुख विशेषता” छेकै ।

दू नेपाली अधिकारी रायटर क॑ बतैलकै कि चीन न॑ ई साल केरऽ शुरू म॑ सहयोग क॑ मजबूत करै लेली एगो बैठक के बाद ग्लेशियर के जोखिम आरू जल स्तर के बारे म॑ बहुत जानकारी नै साझा करलकै, आरू ओकरा आशंका छै कि डाटा साझा करै के कमी स॑ भविष्य म॑ आपदा के तैयारी म॑ बाधा आबी सकै छै ।

चीन केरऽ विदेश मंत्रालय न॑ ई बैठक प॑ टिप्पणी करै के आग्रह के जवाब नै देलकै ।

title: Second Israeli reported missing in Nepal six days after devastating floods - The Jerusalem Post
description: Second Israeli reported missing in Nepal six days after devastating floods  The Jerusalem Post
publisher.title: The Jerusalem Post
full_article:
A 41-year-old Israeli woman has been reported missing in the aftermath of the devastating floods that wrecked Nepal on Wednesday, killing nearly 800 people and leaving more than 3,000 people missing.

Israel's Consulate in Kathmandu and the Foreign Ministry's Situation Center are in contact with the missing woman's family and are working with local authorities in an attempt to locate her.

The woman, who Israel's Foreign Ministry identified as Katrina Sakowitz, is the second Israeli to be declared missing in Nepal. She holds both Israeli and Belarusian citizenship, and has lived in Milan for the last several years, according to KAN News. She was in Nepal as a tourist and did not identify herself as an Israeli citizen there, which KAN said is the Israel's Foreign Ministry did not identify her sooner.

On Thursday, tourism officials announced the first missing Israeli, noting that ZAKA had officially begun investigating their disappearance.

The Foreign Ministry released a statement on Thursday warning citizens to avoid traveling to the area due to the current natural disaster.

A drone view shows mud covering buildings and property following devastating floods at Trishuli in Nuwakot district, Nepal, August 27, 2026. (credit: REUTERS/Navesh Chitrakar)

Red Cross estimates over 90,000 affected

Nepal’s disaster management authority said that 933 people were missing from hydropower projects in the flood-hit region. The Red Cross estimates that more than 90,000 people are likely affected by the disaster, which China has linked to the effects of climate change.

Hundreds of bodies, many unidentified, have been buried in shallow graves as they began decomposing in the humid weather in the plains of the Himalayan country after being swept down the mountains by the torrent.

Beijing has said 261 foreign nationals from 23 countries were unaccounted for in Tibet, near a key border crossing with Nepal.

China’s state-run CCTV reported Beijing has mobilized more than 2,100 rescue workers and allocated at least 220 million yuan ($33 million) to support relief efforts and has been airdropping equipment and supplies to frontline rescuers, while its soldiers used life-detection equipment to look for the missing.

Rescue operations have been suspended several times since Friday because of bad weather and concerns that a lake formed across the Nepal-China border by the disaster could trigger fresh flooding after it began overflowing into Nepal's rivers.

सैकड़ों लाश, जेकरऽ बहुत पहचान नै छै, क॑ उथला कब्र म॑ दफना देलऽ गेलऽ छै, कैन्हेंकि हिमालयी देश केरऽ मैदानऽ म॑ नम मौसम म॑ धार स॑ पहाड़ऽ स॑ बहला के बाद सड़ना शुरू होय गेलऽ छै ।

नेपाल के साथ एक प्रमुख सीमा क्रासिंग के पास तिब्बत में 23 देश के 261 विदेशी नागरिक के बेहिसाब रहल बीजिंग कहलक अछि।

चीन केरऽ सरकारी सीसीटीवी न॑ खबर देल॑ छै कि बीजिंग न॑ 2,100 स॑ भी अधिक बचावकर्मी क॑ जुटान॑ छै आरू राहत प्रयासऽ म॑ सहायता लेली कम स॑ कम 22 करोड़ युआन (3.3 करोड़ डॉलर) के आवंटन करलकै आरू फ्रंटलाइन बचावकर्ता सिनी क॑ उपकरण आरू आपूर्ति हवाई ड्रॉप करी रहलऽ छै, जबकि ओकरऽ सैनिकऽ न॑ लापता लोगऽ क॑ खोजै लेली जीवन-पता लगाबै वाला उपकरण के इस्तेमाल करलकै ।

title: Arizona temple leader among missing in catastrophic Nepal flooding - AZ Family
description: Arizona temple leader among missing in catastrophic Nepal flooding  AZ Family
publisher.title: AZ Family
full_article:
TEMPE, AZ (AZFamily) — A revered spiritual leader from a Tempe temple is among thousands of people still missing after catastrophic flooding tore through Nepal and Tibet last week, killing at least 900 people

The floods were triggered by a glacial collapse high in the Himalayas so severe it registered as a magnitude 5.2 earthquake, sending a torrent of rock and water through valleys in Tibet and Nepal.

Sri Keshava Rao Tadipatri, a Sri Puttige Mutt Asthana Vidwamsaru affiliated with the Sri Venkata Krishna Kshetra Temple in Tempe, was traveling with a group of pilgrims on the sacred Kailash Manasarovar Yatra when the region was hit by Wednesday’s flash floods, temple leaders said.

The temple identified the following fellow pilgrims who were traveling with Tadipatri:

Anil Goel

Srinivas Sudhir Rangu

Mahendra Gupta

Laxminath Gopisetty

Kirti Acharya

Sudhindra Yapalparvi

Vivek Srivastav

Venkat Balasubramanyam

Venkat Bangalore

In a social media statement, the SVK Temple said families, friends and well-wishers are “anxiously” awaiting news of the group and asked the community to keep the pilgrims in their thoughts and prayers as they hope for their safe return.

“May Lord Sri Krishna, Sri Hari Vayu Gurugalu, and the blessings of Poojya Sri Puthige Swamijis, protect them and guide them safely back home,” the temple wrote.

The temple’s anxious wait mirrors a broader unease rippling through Arizona’s Nepalese community, home to roughly 2,000 Nepalese families.

“I’m finding more and more, a lot of people I know are missing,” said Gyan Nyaupane, a Chandler resident from Nepal. “I couldn’t even believe it. It was like watching movie. But unfortunately, it was real, right?”

“It’s super scary, to be honest. It’s very hard to describe,” said Gaurav Adhikari, a Tempe resident from Nepal.

The death toll from last week’s floods has risen past 900, Nepal’s disaster agency announced Sunday night. More than 5,000 people are still missing from Nepal and Tibet.

The Associated Press contributed to this report.

बाढ़ केरऽ शुरुआत हिमालय केरऽ ऊँचाई वाला हिमखंड केरऽ पतन के वजह स॑ छेलै जे एतना गंभीर छेलै कि ई ५.२ तीव्रता के भूकंप के रूप म॑ दर्ज होय गेलै, जेकरा स॑ तिब्बत आरू नेपाल केरऽ घाटी के माध्यम स॑ चट्टान आरू पानी केरऽ धार भेजलऽ गेलै ।

मंदिर के नेता सब कहलनि जे, टेम्पे के श्री वेंकट कृष्ण क्षेत्र मंदिर सं जुड़ल श्री पुट्टीगे मट्ट अस्थाना विद्वमसारू श्री केशव राव तादीपत्री पवित्र कैलाश मनसरोवर यात्रा पर तीर्थयात्री के एकटा समूह के संग यात्रा क रहल छलाह, जखन कि बुधदिन के झटका बाढ़ि के चपेट मे आबि गेल छल.

मंदिर में निम्नलिखित साथी तीर्थयात्री के पहचान करलऽ गेलै जे तादीपत्री के साथ यात्रा करी रहलऽ छेलै :

अनिल गोएल

श्रीनिवास सुधीर रंगू

महेन्द्र गुप्ता

लक्ष्मीनाथ गोपीसेट्टी

कीर्ति आचार्य

सुधीन्द्र यपालपर्वी

विवेक श्रीवास्तव

वेंकट बालासुब्रह्मण्यम्

वेंकट बेंगलुरु

सोशल मीडिया पर जारी बयान मँ एसवीके मंदिर नँ कहलकै कि परिवार, दोस्त आरू शुभचिंतक समूह केरौ खबर के इंतजार “बेतुरता स॑” करी रहलऽ छै आरू समुदाय स॑ कहलकै कि तीर्थयात्री सिनी क॑ अपनऽ विचार आरू प्रार्थना म॑ रखना छै, कैन्हेंकि ओकरा सुरक्षित वापसी के उम्मीद छै ।

मंदिर में लिखल गेल अछि, “भगवान श्री कृष्ण, श्री हरि वायु गुरुगालू, आ पूजा श्री पुठीगे स्वामीजी के आशीर्वाद, हुनकर रक्षा करथि आ हुनका सब के सुरक्षित रूप स घर वापसी के मार्गदर्शन करथि।”

मंदिर केरऽ बेचैन इंतजार एरिजोना केरऽ नेपाली समुदाय म॑ लहरतें हुअ॑ एगो व्यापक बेचैनी के प्रतिबिंब छेकै, जेकरा म॑ लगभग २००० नेपाली परिवार रहै छै ।

नेपाल के चांडलर निवासी ज्ञान न्याउपाने कहलनि जे, हमरा बेसी स’ बेसी भेटि रहल अछि, हमरा जनैत बहुत रास लोक गायब छथि। “हमरा विश्वासो नहि भ’ रहल छल. ई त’ सिनेमा देखब जकाँ छल. मुदा दुर्भाग्यवश, ई असली छल ने?”

नेपालक टेम्पे निवासी गौरव अधिकारी कहलनि जे, ईमानदारी स’ कहब त’ सुपर डरावना अछि, एकर वर्णन करब बहुत कठिन अछि।

पिछला सप्ताह के बाढ़ि सं मृतक के संख्या 900 सं बेसि भ गेल अछि, नेपाल के आपदा एजेंसी रविदिन राति मे घोषणा केलक अछि. नेपाल आ तिब्बत सँ एखनहु ५ हजार सँ बेसी लोक लापता अछि ।

एहि रिपोर्ट मे एसोसिएटेड प्रेस क योगदान अछि।

हमरा लोकनिक कथा मे वर्तनी वा व्याकरणिक त्रुटि देखैत छी ? एकर रिपोर्ट करय लेल एतय क्लिक करू.

अहाँ लग कोनो ब्रेकिंग न्यूज स्टोरी के फोटो या वीडियो अछि? संक्षिप्त विवरणक संग एतय पठाबी।

title: Nepal teams seek hundreds trapped in hydropower tunnels after deadly floods - Yahoo

By Gopal Sharma, Saurabh Sharma and Ethan Wang

KATHMANDU/BEIJING, Aug 31 (Reuters) - Nepal's rescue teams, helped by Chinese and Indian experts, stepped up efforts on Monday to reach hundreds of people believed to be stuck inside blocked hydropower project tunnels in the aftermath of last week's Himalayan flood.

The unprecedented deluge of ice, rock, mud and debris carved a trail of ‌destruction in the country's valley towns and villages, as well as across the border in China, on Wednesday, killing more than 900 people, with nearly 5,000 still missing.

A glacier collapse ‌is thought to have triggered the disaster.

Hundreds of bodies, many unidentified, have been buried in shallow graves as they began decomposing in the humid weather in the plains of the Himalayan country after being swept down the mountains by the torrent.

SEARCH TEAMS ​USE CONTROLLED BLASTS

Nepali officials said that the focus was on reaching the 933 workers believed to be trapped at 11 hydropower projects, including many who were working in about half a dozen tunnels, in the two hard-hit districts of Rasuwa and Nuwakot.

Pictures and videos shared by rescue teams showed earth-moving equipment digging and shovelling mud and rocks under lights in the dark of the night as workers watched. Soldiers used torchlight in a big pit they had created to look for space to get into one tunnel.

The Nepali army said search-and-rescue teams were using controlled blasts, excavators and searchlights to clear water and mud and reach trapped people. ‌Teams recovered three bodies after entering two tunnels, while other sections remained ⁠buried in mud and were still being searched, it said.

"A large amount of debris has been deposited and that is posing us a big challenge to open the tunnels," Nepali army spokesperson Raja Ram Basnet said. "Our main focus is on opening the tunnels."

NEPAL'S HYDROPOWER PROJECTS BOOM

On Monday, Nepali authorities said 903 people were ⁠confirmed dead, with 4,247 missing, including the 933 at hydropower projects. On the Chinese side, authorities said 16 people were killed in Gyirong County and 546 were missing.

The Nepali foreign ministry said that about 590 foreign nationals from 39 countries were still missing. More than 10,000 people had been rescued from the flood-hit region, including 323 foreign nationals, it added.

The Red Cross has estimated that more than 90,000 people were likely to have been affected ​by ​the disaster, which China has linked to the effects of climate change.

There has been a boom in hydropower projects ​in Nepal since the turn of the century as the mountainous country sought ‌to take advantage of its Himalayan water resources to address chronic domestic power shortages and exploit prospects for selling electricity to southern neighbour India.

Hydropower projects in Nepal's mountains need tunnels to carry water through the steep terrain, allowing developers to exploit the sharp elevation drop between Himalayan rivers and powerhouses to generate electricity.

Prime Minister Balendra Shah said the flood was an "unprecedented and devastating natural disaster" and it remained challenging to compile a complete assessment of the damage.

Beijing has said 261 foreign nationals from 23 countries were unaccounted for in Tibet, near a key border crossing with Nepal.

On Monday, Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said that nearly 100 Chinese citizens have not been contactable on the Nepalese side.

A meeting of the Chinese cabinet urged all-out effort to search for the missing, the release of authoritative information, addressing risks ‌and hidden dangers and further improvement of emergency management capabilities, state television CCTV said.

RISK FROM LAKES AND LANDSLIDES

Although Nepal ​has said that it does not need foreign help in general rescue and search, it has leaned on giant neighbours ​India and China for their expertise in tunnel rescue.

Rescue operations have been suspended several times ​because of bad weather and concerns that a lake formed across the Nepal-China border by the disaster could trigger fresh flooding after it began overflowing into Nepal's ‌rivers.

On Monday, CCTV said that glaciers around an impact crater carved out near ​the site of last week's glacier collapse on the ​Nepalese side remained at risk of collapse. Drone footage showed multiple landslide deposits along both riverbanks, posing a risk of further collapses and the formation of new lakes, it said.

Last week's flood was "caused by glacier instability under the long-term effects of global warming", the state broadcaster reported.

Two Nepali officials told Reuters that China had not shared much information on glacier risks and ​water levels following a meeting to strengthen cooperation earlier this year, and ‌they feared that a lack of data-sharing could hamper future disaster preparedness.

The Chinese foreign ministry said that Beijing had continuously provided Nepal with meteorological and hydrological data and would ​continue to "strongly support" Nepal's disaster relief efforts and safeguard the two countries' common interests.

गोपाल शर्मा, सौरभ शर्मा एवं एतान वांग द्वारा

काठमाण्डु, ३१ अगस्त (मिथिला मिररः) : पिछला सप्ताह हिमालयी बाढ़िक बाद अवरुद्ध जलविद्युत परियोजना सुरंगक भीतर फंसल मानल जा रहल सैकड़ों लोक तक पहुँचबाक लेल चीनी आ भारतीय विशेषज्ञक सहयोगमे नेपालक बचाव दल सोमदिन प्रयास तेज केलक अछि ।

बर्फ, चट्टान, कीचड़ आरू मलबा केरऽ अभूतपूर्व बाढ़ न॑ बुधवार क॑ देश केरऽ घाटी शहर आरू गाँवऽ के साथ-साथ चीन केरऽ सीमा पार म॑ भी तबाही के निशान उकेरलकै, जेकरा म॑ ९०० स॑ भी अधिक लोगऽ के मौत होय गेलै, जबकि लगभग ५,००० लोग अखनी तलक लापता छै ।

सैकड़ों लाश, जेकरऽ बहुत पहचान नै छै, क॑ उथला कब्र म॑ दफना देलऽ गेलऽ छै, कैन्हेंकि हिमालयी देश केरऽ मैदानऽ म॑ नम मौसम म॑ धार स॑ पहाड़ऽ स॑ बहला के बाद सड़ना शुरू होय गेलऽ छै ।

खोज टीम नियंत्रित ब्लास्ट के प्रयोग करैत अछि |

नेपाली अधिकारी सब कहलनि जे, कठिन प्रभावित दू जिला रसुवा आ नुवाकोट मे करीब आधा दर्जन सुरंग मे काज करय वाला बहुतो सहित 11 जलविद्युत परियोजना मे फंसल मानल गेल 933 मजदूर तक पहुंचे पर ध्यान देल गेल अछि।

बचाव टीम द्वारा साझा करलऽ गेलऽ तस्वीर आरू वीडियो म॑ देखलऽ गेलऽ छै कि रात के अन्हार म॑ धरती क॑ हिलाय वाला उपकरणऽ क॑ रोशनी के नीचें कीचड़ आरू चट्टान क॑ खोदना आरू फावड़ा स॑ उड़ाबै के काम करलऽ गेलऽ छै, जबकि मजदूर सब देखै छेलै । सैनिक सब अपन बनाओल एकटा पैघ गड्ढा में मशाल के रोशनी के उपयोग क एकटा सुरंग में घुसय लेल जगह खोजैत छल.

नेपाली सेना प्रवक्ता राजा राम बस्नेत कहलनि जे, भारी मात्रा मे मलबा जमा भ गेल अछि आ ताहि सँ सुरंग खोलबाक लेल हमरा सब केँ पैघ चुनौती बनि रहल अछि। "हमर मुख्य ध्यान सुरंग खोलबा पर अछि।"

नेपालक जल-पावर परियोजनाक उछाल

सोमदिन नेपाली अधिकारी 903 गोटेक मृत्यु ⁠पुष्टि भेल अछि, जाहिमे जलविद्युत परियोजनामे ९३३ गोटे सहित ४,२४७ गोटे लापता अछि । चीनी पक्ष के तरफ सं अधिकारी के कहनाय छनि जे ग्यिरॉंग काउंटी मे 16 लोक के मौत भ गेल अछि आओर 546 लोक लापता अछि.

रेड क्रॉस केरऽ अनुमान छै कि ई आपदा स॑ ९०,००० स॑ भी अधिक लोगऽ क॑ प्रभावित होय के संभावना छेलै, जेकरा चीन न॑ जलवायु परिवर्तन केरऽ प्रभाव स॑ जोड़लकै ।

शताब्दी के मोड़ स॑ ही नेपाल म॑ जलविद्युत परियोजना म॑ उछाल आबी रहलऽ छै, कैन्हेंकि पहाड़ी देश न॑ अपनऽ हिमालयी जल संसाधन के लाभ उठाबै के कोशिश करी क॑ पुरानी घरेलू बिजली के कमी क॑ दूर करै आरू दक्षिणी पड़ोसी देश भारत क॑ बिजली बेचै के संभावना के दोहन करै के कोशिश करलकै ।

title: Death toll from Nepal floods tops 900 - Washington Examiner
description: Death toll from Nepal floods tops 900  Washington Examiner
publisher.title: Washington Examiner
full_article:
The death toll from sudden and deadly floods in Nepal, China, and Tibet topped 900, with the total certain to rise considerably as rescuers try to reach those trapped by the disaster.

Nepal’s National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority put the latest number of confirmed dead at 903. Some of the bodies were recovered 150 miles from ground zero of the flood, which swept away thousands on Wednesday. The government put the number of missing at 4,250, and rescuers are currently focusing on reaching 933 missing people who are believed to be trapped in the tunnels of six hydropower projects.

In this photo released by Xinhua News Agency, rescuers use sniffer dogs to search for victims at a mudslide-hit area in Gyirong County, southwestern China’s Tibet Autonomous Region, Sunday, Aug. 30, 2026. (Jigme Dorje/Xinhua via AP)

“A large amount of debris has been deposited and that is posing us a big challenge to open the tunnels,” Nepal army spokesman Raja Ram Basnet said.

Rescuer Ashish Gurung told the Guardian that the rescue teams remain hopeful, as the hydropower company had provided maps of the underground infrastructure showing there were areas where they could be holding out. “They have a safe area inside,” he said. “Some of them could potentially be alive. I am hoping they are alive.” Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah said that nearly 21,000 security personnel were deployed for rescue operations, with many more civilian volunteers assisting. Advertisement “Despite the adverse weather, difficult terrain, and continuing risks, we are moving forward with determination to save the lives of our citizens,” he said late on Sunday. Nepal has relied on specialized tunnel rescue teams from China and India to help with the rescue. NEPAL WARNS OF POSSIBLE FRESH FLOODING AS COMMUNITIES GRAPPLE WITH DEVASTATION Advertisement Wednesday’s flood was caused when a massive 2,000-foot-wide piece of glacier broke off from high on a mountain, plunging 7,000 feet into a river and melting on impact. The glacier collapse and debris flow were so powerful that the U.S. Geological Survey originally labeled it as an earthquake, equivalent to a magnitude 5.2 earthquake. Hundreds of foreigners are among the thousands currently missing, including at least 85 American citizens.

नेपाल, चीन, आरू तिब्बत म॑ अचानक आरू घातक बाढ़ स॑ मृतकऽ के संख्या ९०० स॑ ऊपर पहुँची गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ कुल संख्या म॑ काफी बढ़ोत्तरी निश्चित छै, कैन्हेंकि बचावकर्ता आपदा म॑ फंसलऽ लोगऽ तलक पहुँचै के कोशिश करी रहलऽ छै ।

नेपाल केरऽ राष्ट्रीय आपदा जोखिम कम करै आरू प्रबंधन प्राधिकरण न॑ ताजा मृतक के संख्या ९०३ बतैलकै ।बुधवार क॑ हजारों लोगऽ क॑ बहय वाला बाढ़ केरऽ ग्राउंड जीरो स॑ १५० मील दूर कुछ शव बरामद करलऽ गेलै । सरकार न॑ लापता लोगऽ के संख्या ४,२५० बतैलकै, आरू बचावकर्मी अभी ९३३ लापता लोगऽ तलक पहुँचै प॑ ध्यान केंद्रित करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा प॑ मानलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै कि वू छह जलविद्युत परियोजना के सुरंगऽ म॑ फंसलऽ छै ।

अनुशंसित कहानी नेपाल के बाढ़ स॑ मृतक के संख्या ९०० स॑ ऊपर छै ट्रंप न॑ ‘खर्ग द्वीप क॑ उड़ाबै के वीडियो क॑ चकनाचूर करी देलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै’ मरीन ले पेन केरऽ आखिरी स्टैंड के वीडियो पोस्ट करलकै : नेशनल रैली केरऽ नेता न॑ पिछला तीन हार के बाद २०२७ केरऽ राष्ट्रपति चुनाव लेली बहुत आगू मतदान करी रहलऽ छै

सिन्हुआ न्यूज एजेंसी द्वारा जारी ई फोटो म॑ बचावकर्ता न॑ चीन केरऽ दक्षिण-पश्चिमी तिब्बत स्वायत्त क्षेत्र केरऽ ग्यिरॉंग काउंटी म॑ मडस्लाइड स॑ प्रभावित क्षेत्र म॑ पीड़ितऽ के खोज करै लेली सुंघै वाला कुत्ता के इस्तेमाल करी क॑ पीड़ितऽ के खोज करलकै, रविवार, ३० अगस्त २०२६ ।(जिग्मे डोर्जे/सिन्हुआ वाया एपी)

नेपाल सेनाके प्रवक्ता राजा राम बस्नेत कहलनि जे, भारी मात्रा मे मलबा जमा भ गेल अछि आ ताहि सँ हमरा सबके सुरंग खोलबाक पैघ चुनौती बनि रहल अछि।

विज्ञापन

बचावकर्मी आशीष गुरुंग न॑ गार्जियन क॑ बतैलकै कि बचाव टीम आशावादी बनलऽ छै, कैन्हेंकि जलविद्युत कंपनी न॑ भूमिगत बुनियादी ढाँचा के नक्शा उपलब्ध कराय देल॑ छै जेकरा स॑ पता चलै छै कि ऐसनऽ क्षेत्र छै, जहां वू टिकलऽ रह॑ सकै छै । ओ कहलनि जे, हुनका सब के अंदर सुरक्षित इलाका अछि। "ओहि मे सँ किछु संभावित रूप सँ जीवित भ' सकैत अछि, हम आशा क' रहल छी जे ओ जीवित छथि।" नेपालके प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाह बटैलै कि बचाव कार्यके लेल लगभग २१ हजार सुरक्षाकर्मी तैनात कएल गेल अछि, जाहिमे आरो बहुत रास नागरिक स्वयंसेवक सहयोग केने छल । विज्ञापन रविदिन देर राति ओ कहलनि जे, प्रतिकूल मौसम, कठिन इलाका, आ लगातार जोखिम के बावजूद हम सब अपन नागरिक के जान बचाबय के संकल्प के संग आगू बढ़ि रहल छी। नेपाल चीन आ भारत के विशेष सुरंग बचाव दल पर निर्भर रहल अछि जे बचाव मे मदद करत। नेपाल म॑ संभावित ताजा बाढ़ के चेतावनी छै, कैन्हेंकि समुदायऽ म॑ तबाही के सामना करना पड़ै छै विज्ञापन बुधवार केरऽ बाढ़ के कारण एगो पहाड़ प॑ २,००० फीट चौड़ाई के एगो विशाल ग्लेशियर के टुकड़ा ऊँचऽ स॑ टूटी क॑ ७,००० फीट नदी म॑ डूबी गेलै आरू टक्कर लगला प॑ पिघली गेलै । ग्लेशियर केरऽ पतन आरू मलबा केरऽ प्रवाह एतना शक्तिशाली छेलै कि यू.एस. एखन लापता हजारों मे सैकड़ों विदेशी शामिल छथि, जाहि मे कम स कम 85 अमेरिकी नागरिक सेहो शामिल छथि।

Drone shows Nepal devastation as army responds to deadly floods

Drone footage captured the banks of the Trishuli river on Aug. 31 as Nepal's army scrambled to locate survivors after devastating flash floods.
